title: ToolEvent
description: Payload of a tool-output event in the session log (Q69), validated before it is appended. `kind` equals the event's `type`; the writer checks that relation.

offloaded.title: ToolOutputOffloaded
offloaded.description: A tool result over the threshold was written whole to `<stateDir>/offload/<sha256>.txt`, outside the sandbox workspace, and the engine saw a head and tail preview plus a pointer line built from this payload alone. `truncatedAtSource` is true when the sandbox hit its capture ceiling, so the file is itself cut.

toolCallId.description: The engine's tool call ID, as in the loop events: printable ASCII without spaces, 1 to 256 characters.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the offloaded text (UTF-8), which names its file.

bytes.description: Size of the offloaded text in UTF-8 bytes.

pointerVersion.description: Which pointer text the engine saw (Q69). Absent means 1, the original text; 2 adds the hint to search the file with `offload.grep`. The pointer is a pure function of this payload, so an old log keeps its old text on replay.
